protocolsBeforeMove.description: Review and debate protocol presets, the lens catalogue and the locked invariants (119 IC-001). Presets are registry data behind one validator (src/runtime/review/protocols.ts). review.* and debate.* settings choose among them; the invariants are never settings.

lenses.description: red on base, green on head, revert control red
guards, docs blocks, typecheck, changelog, no new dependency, no legacy left

invariants.statement: A seat is never the agent or the session that authored the reviewed change
Seats are read-only; the synthesizer sat as no seat
Verify PASS on the reviewed head before any seat
The class seat floor can be raised, never lowered
Findings contract: schema, severities, verdicts, locator plus reproducer, every finding answered
Fix and gate decisions stay under the person-only and ask-first rules
